title: SZA Pops Up at Don Toliver’s NYC Show — and the Crowd Goes Wild!
summary: Imagine you’re at a concert, and suddenly your favorite singer walks on stage — but they weren’t even on the poster! That’s what happened Monday night at Madison Square Garden in New York City. Rapper Don Toliver was in the middle of his Octane Tour when SZA appeared. The crowd screamed so loud you could probably hear it blocks away. SZA came out from a stage that looked like a giant space observatory to sing “Used,” a song they made together in 2022. After the song, SZA gave Don a big hug and told the audience, “Make some noise for Don Toliver! Listen, I might be your biggest fan. I’m not joking.” She said his new album Octane is incredible. But wait — there’s more! Sheck Wes jumped on stage and performed “Mo Bamba,” a song so hype it felt like the building might shake apart. Peso Pluma sang “La Bebe (Remix)” and even played a brand-new song he made with Don that no one had heard before. Another artist, SahBabii, came back out to do their song “K9.” The night started and ended with Don’s hit “E85.” For the final version, he brought out Malcolm Todd, whose voice is sampled in the track. Don Toliver’s album Octane came out in January and went straight to No. 1. He’s been touring North America, and next stops are Baltimore, Detroit, and Toronto. If you get a chance to see him, who knows? You might get a surprise guest too.
why_it_matters: Surprise guests at concerts show that live music can be full of unexpected fun, just like a surprise party — and you might see your favorite artists team up for moments that only happen once.

WHAT: They performed hit songs and a brand-new unreleased track during his Octane Tour show.
WHERE: At Madison Square Garden, a huge arena in New York City.
WHY: To celebrate Don Toliver’s No. 1 album and give the audience an unforgettable night.
